questions.question: What is a flowchart?
questions.answer: A graphical representation of an algorithm or process.

questions.answer: They indicate the direction of execution.

Flowcharts can be used before writing program code.
Explain why flowcharts are useful during software development.
questions.answer: Flowcharts help visualize program logic, simplify problem-solving, improve communication, and make debugging and maintenance easier.
